alternative_notation.dimension_formula: osp(2m|2n) with m=1; even = 2n^2 + n + 1, odd = 4n

kappa.label: kappa
kappa.role: odd central element carrying the inhomogeneous deformation (Schema 2+)

K.label: K
K.role: even central element; identified with the scalar 1, excluded from basis/PBW

evaluated_bracket: [X,Y]_gamma = [X,Y]_0 (Schema 1) + kappa * sum_Z coeff * Z ;  Z='K' = central kappa*1

profiles.name: fermion_sign
profiles.description: gb_{a_1^sigma, b} = +1 for sigma=+, -1 for sigma=-

profiles.name: boson_sign
profiles.description: gb_{a, b_j^s} = +1 for s=+, -1 for s=-

profiles.name: alternating_j
profiles.description: gb = (-1)^(j+1) (sign alternates with the boson mode j)
